Reach for this skill when agents need to set up channels, manage sessions, configure models, create custom skills, or debug agent behavior. metadata: mintlify-proj: clawdbot version: "1.0" --- # OpenClaw Skill ## Product summary OpenClaw is a self-hosted gateway that connects messaging apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, iMessage, Slack, Signal, and more) to an embedded AI coding agent. It runs as a single daemon process on your machine or server, manages multi-channel routing, handles sessions and memory, and provides a web Control UI for chat and configuration.
